posts.name: Wotto
posts.tagline: a tiny otter in your menu bar reminds you to drink water
posts.description: wotto is a small otter who lives on your mac and has exactly one wish: that you drink enough water. he sits quietly on your desktop while you work. log a glass from the menu bar and he does a happy little drink. fall behind and he gets visibly thirsty on your behalf. finish your daily goal and he hands you a flower. no arguments. - streaks and a weekly view to keep the habit going - set your own wake hours, goal, and reminder pace - "i need a push" take-over reminder made with love by suhani.

posts.name: LifeCalc
posts.tagline: Calculators that show total cost - not just monthly payments
posts.description: Most calculators answer the wrong question. "Can I afford the monthly payment?" is easy. The hard question is: Should I? LifeCalc shows total cost, trade-offs, and opportunity cost — not just monthly payments. 7 free calculators: Mortgage, Rent vs. Buy, Car Loan, Credit Card, Line of Credit, Renovation, and Recreation (boats/RVs). No signup. No email. No friction. Just the numbers. Built for people who already know if they can afford it — and need help deciding if they should.
